subject: spanish

rounds.why: Another false friend — “constipado” means “to have a cold”. “Constipated” is “estreñido”.
truths: “Llevo una vida sana” means “I lead a healthy life”.
“Evito la comida basura” means “I avoid junk food”.

rounds.lie: En “las Fallas” de Valencia, the giant figures are kept in a museum forever.
rounds.why: At “las Fallas” the giant figures are paraded and then burnt in huge bonfires in March, not kept forever.
rounds.truth: En “las Fallas” de Valencia, the giant figures are burnt in bonfires.

rounds.why: “Equilibrada” means “balanced”, so it means “a balanced diet”, not a strict one (“estricta”).

truths: “Me llevo bien con mis padres” means “I get on well with my parents”.
“Soy hijo único” means “I am an only child”.

rounds.lie: “El estrés me agobia” means “stress relaxes me”.
rounds.why: “Agobiar” means “to overwhelm/stress out”, so it means “stress overwhelms me”, the opposite of relaxing.
rounds.truth: “El estrés me agobia” means “stress overwhelms me”.
truths: “Llevar una vida sana” means “to lead a healthy life”.

rounds.why: “Semana” means “week”, so “la Semana Santa” means “Holy Week” (Easter), not a month.
